review_locator: PMCID:PMC4505771, Utilizing Fibronectin Integrin-Binding Specificity to Control Cellular Responses; PMCID:PMC3730317, Integrin alpha5beta1 review
primary_title: Structure of integrin alpha5beta1 in complex with fibronectin; Structural insights into integrin alpha5beta1 opening by fibronectin ligand
decision_basis: The reviews identify alpha5beta1 as the fibronectin receptor and cite structural studies resolving fibronectin engagement of the alpha5beta1 headpiece and ligand-induced integrin opening.
limitations_preserved: Preserve alpha5beta1 heterodimer, fibronectin RGD/synergy-module context, and structural/receptor-binding scope; no universal integrin kinase relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2811424, Laminin-binding integrins and their tetraspanin partners as potential antimetastatic targets; PMCID:PMC5669817, Regulation of the Immune System by Laminins
primary_title: Structural mechanism of laminin recognition by integrin
decision_basis: The reviews identify alpha6beta1 as a laminin-511 receptor and the cited primary study resolves direct interaction of alpha6beta1 with a three-chain laminin-511 fragment across the integrin and laminin interface.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the three-chain laminin-511 E8 fragment and alpha6beta1 heterodimer; structural/cell-surface binding scope only, with no universal integrin kinase relay or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2901818, Integrin alphaVbeta3-Targeted Cancer Therapy; PMID:12500288, alphav Vitronectin receptors in vascular-mediated disorders
primary_title: Transmembrane-truncated alphavbeta3 integrin retains high affinity for ligand binding: evidence for an inside-out suppressor?
decision_basis: The reviews identify alphaVbeta3 as a principal vitronectin receptor and the cited primary study shows purified recombinant alphaVbeta3 retains high-affinity vitronectin binding, with cell-surface and Mn2+-dependent activation comparisons.
limitations_preserved: Preserve vitronectin RGD ligand form, alphaVbeta3 heterodimer, and purified versus cell-surface activation-state distinction; no autonomous ITGAV relay or SCI inference.
